title: Comprehensive Mapping of Functional Enhancers in Chinese Hamster Ovary Cells.
authors: Santos, Maria; Johari, Yusuf B; Biggins, Laura; Elliott, Natalie C; Schoenfelder, Stefan; Boddireddy, Mounika; Fabian, Daniel K; Anbar, Michael; O'Callaghan, Peter M; Rugg-Gunn, Peter J
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过STARR-seq和深度学习识别CHO细胞增强子及TF基序，虽涉及TF-DNA结合位点预测，但核心是增强子功能图谱而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells are the leading mammalian system for recombinant therapeutic protein production. However, optimizing transgene expression remains challenging due to the limited understanding of the regulatory mechanisms controlling gene expression in CHO cells. Towards overcoming this barrier, here we provide a systematic characterization of cis-regulatory elements in CHO cells. Using genome-wide STARR-seq, a high-throughput method for quantifying enhancer strength, we identified regions with enhancer activity in the CHO cell genome. By integrating these data with ATAC-seq and histone modification profiles, we were able to characterize the chromatin state of these regions. Our analysis revealed thousands of newly identified enhancer sequences. The most active sequences could drive transgene expression at levels similar to or higher than strong viral enhancers. Notably, half of the regions found to have enhancer activity were within inaccessible chromatin in their native context. We observed that accessible enhancers were primarily near to transcriptional start sites and associated with ubiquitously-expressed genes, whereas inaccessible enhancers were predominantly intergenic and associated with tissue-specific genes. Additionally, through a deep-learning-based approach ETS and YY1 transcription factor (TF) binding motifs were identified as key determinants of enhancer identity and strength. Disrupting YY1 binding motifs led to reduced enhancer activity, thereby highlighting the importance of YY1 as a transcriptional activator in CHO cells. Our study demonstrates the first comprehensive map of functionally-validated enhancers in CHO cells and generates new insights into gene regulation and the role of TFs in determining enhancer strength. This study helps to lay the foundation for strategic engineering of CHO cell transcriptional networks to achieve enhanced biopharmaceutical production.
abstract_zh: 中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞是重组治疗性蛋白生产的主要哺乳动物系统。然而，由于对CHO细胞中控制基因表达的调控机制理解有限，优化转基因表达仍具挑战性。为克服这一障碍，我们在此对CHO细胞中的顺式调控元件进行了系统表征。利用全基因组STARR-seq（一种高通量量化增强子强度的方法），我们鉴定了CHO细胞基因组中具有增强子活性的区域。通过将这些数据与ATAC-seq和组蛋白修饰谱整合，我们能够表征这些区域的染色质状态。我们的分析揭示了数千个新鉴定的增强子序列。最具活性的序列能以与强病毒增强子相似或更高的水平驱动转基因表达。值得注意的是，发现具有增强子活性的区域中有一半在其天然环境中位于不可及的染色质内。我们观察到，可及的增强子主要靠近转录起始位点，并与普遍表达的基因相关，而不可及的增强子则主要位于基因间区域，并与组织特异性基因相关。此外，通过基于深度学习的方法，ETS和YY1转录因子（TF）结合基序被确定为增强子身份和强度的关键决定因素。破坏YY1结合基序导致增强子活性降低，从而突显了YY1作为CHO细胞中转录激活因子的重要性。我们的研究提供了CHO细胞中功能验证增强子的首个全面图谱，并为基因调控及TF在决定增强子强度中的作用提供了新见解。这项研究为战略性工程化CHO细胞转录网络以实现增强的生物制药生产奠定了基础。
